description: Rule-based price range (low/mid/high) for a used car from its VIN or Dutch plate (or make/model/year), mileage and condition – the same estimate as the website. Price when new, in this order: newPrice, the RDW list price of a Dutch plate, the typical new price of the make + model + year from RDW open data (about 500 listed models; vehicle.make and vehicle.model are matched by name), else a car class (small, compact, family, suv, premium). Not a valuation; it explains every step and the typical dealer gap. In EUR; with country PL the result is in PLN (EUR sources converted at the ECB reference rate, class bands in PLN). Nothing is stored.

carClass.description: Optional car class when the model is not listed and the price when new is unknown: small, compact, family, suv or premium

country.description: Optional market; PL gives the result in PLN

newPrice.description: Approximate price when new in EUR (needed when the decoder has no list price, unless carClass is given)

vehicle.description: Instead of VIN/plate or as overrides: make, model, year, firstRegistration (YYYY-MM-DD), listPrice

name: estimate_price
title: Estimate a used-car price
